items.title: As low-effort AI slop continues to flood Steam, yet more developers announce game delays caused by Steam's growing approval backlog
items.zh_title: 低质 AI 垃圾游戏持续涌入 Steam，更多开发者因审核积压宣布延期
items.zh_oneliner: Steam 审核积压日益严重，越来越多独立开发者被迫推迟游戏发售，矛头指向低质 AI 生成游戏的泛滥。

items.title: XBOX Playback is Here: Look Back at Your XBOX Story
items.zh_title: XBOX Playback 来了：回顾你的 XBOX 历程
items.zh_oneliner: Xbox 推出 25 周年回顾功能 Playback，可按个人游玩历史生成跨世代亮点总结。

items.title: "It's about giving more great games a chance" – Why Launchable thinks it can help more independent studios reach the market with its shared success model
items.zh_title: “为了让更多好游戏有机会”：Launchable 想用共享成功模式帮独立工作室走向市场
items.zh_oneliner: 新平台 Launchable 以共享成功模式连接工作室与开发人才及发行服务，帮独立团队触达市场。

items.title: Talking Point: What's Your Favourite Tiny Tweak In Zelda: Ocarina Of Time?

items.zh_oneliner: Switch 2 版《时之笛》保留了原作风貌，也加入不少让老玩家津津乐道的小调整。
